xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2032023-07-2115-18-30" status="finalized"><milestone unit="section" n="Conclusive verses (209a5–209a8)"/>dge legs yon tan kun gyi gzhi' || shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul || ston pa nyid kyis legs gsungs shing ||  de'i gsal byed <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">mngon rtogs rgyan</rs> || <rs type="deity">mgon po</rs> yis ni sbyar ba mdzad ||  de dag rnaM par 'byed pa ni || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">bla ma seng ge bzang po</rs>s <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="209a6"/> mdzad || de dag rnaM par <choice><corr>'thad</corr><orig>'thag</orig></choice> pa ni || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma daM pa</rs>'i rjes 'brangs nas ||  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">shag kya'i dge slong byang ye</rs>s byas ||</seg></TEI>
